description: This file defines the internal class NatsStreamMessage used for serializing and deserializing NATS stream messages, including properties for stream ID, request context, payload, and reply-to address. It also includes a partial class for JSON serialization context specific to NatsStreamMessage.

classes.name: NatsStreamMessage
classes.description: Represents a message in the NATS streaming system with properties for stream identification, request context, payload, and reply address.

classes.name: NatsSerializerContext
classes.description: Partial class providing JSON serialization context for NatsStreamMessage with specific serialization options.

methods.name: NatsStreamMessage
methods.description: Constructor for the NatsStreamMessage class (implicit, default).

methods.name: NatsSerializerContext
methods.description: Partial class for JSON serialization context, generated for NatsStreamMessage.
